authority: Department of Land Resources, Government of India; data entries supplied by State Governments/UT Administrations
sourceUpdatedBy: State Governments/UT Administrations and Department of Land Resources; dashboard does not expose a single national as-of timestamp
scope: National aggregate KPIs. State/project/district detailed report is an interactive public query requiring selection on the LACRRIS website; detailed query results are not represented as a packaged nationwide case export.

coverage.notInSnapshotInterpretation: A state with no bundled row is not classified as having zero acquisition. Query the official report and preserve its returned status.

parcelJoinLimit: The public report schema does not expose a universal cadastral parcel ID/plot/khasra/dag field. Do not infer parcel-level acquired/not-acquired status from project-area totals.
freshnessNote: The later public web-index snapshot observed on 14-Nov-2026 reports 4,862 projects, 7,244 segments and 1,885,809 hectares. The dashboard does not expose an exact national data-as-of timestamp; treat as an indexed public snapshot and recheck live before legal/operational reliance.
retrievalMethod: Official public LACRRIS dashboard result indexed approximately two weeks before 14-Nov-2026; the dashboard landing page does not expose an as-of timestamp.
